figurative_meaning_en: Clamor or uproar from many people shouting together
example_sentences_in_bangla: বাজারে চেঁচামেচি করে সবাই কেনাকাটা করছে।
সভায় এত চেঁচামেচি হচ্ছে যে কিছু শোনা যাচ্ছে না।
example_sentences_in_english: The market was filled with hubbub as everyone shouted to buy and sell.
The meeting turned into an uproar with everyone talking at once.
note: Standard spelling is 'চেঁচামেচি'; input variant 'চ্যাঁচামেচি' may be a transliteration error. This idiom is onomatopoeic, mimicking sounds of chatter.
